scope: v0.26.5 RC1 attempt 13 supersedes attempt 12 and combines the user-verified native streaming controller backend with one unified Windows pointer experience. HuymaierUnifiedCursorHost.exe temporarily replaces Windows standard cursor shapes with the gold Huymaier circle whenever Huymaier Console owns foreground focus or a curated native streaming app is active, so the white Windows arrow cannot sit on top of the Huymaier cursor. Physical mouse and controller therefore share the same actual OS pointer. WebView no longer uses its JavaScript virtual-cursor motion path for controller movement; Web content routes through the same native Raw-HID/GameInput OS-pointer path that already works smoothly in Prime Video and Netflix, preserving radial 2-D stick movement, right-stick scrolling, A/Cross click, X/Square keyboard and shared 40-200% cursor speed. Native streaming fullscreen is strengthened by trying the app-native fullscreen shortcut first, then stripping standard and extended non-client chrome, disabling DWM non-client rendering and forcing the root window to monitor bounds; Game Bar remains globally available above native apps through the Sony PS/Guide transport and external-owner overlay path. This attempt also fixes the active-download library refresh regression: provider/storefront Install or Update progress is telemetry-only and may update Downloads cards in place but must never rebuild Games, provider-transfers.json no longer forces provider-state dirty on each telemetry aggregate, provider catalog invalidation is deferred, and a successful terminal install/update schedules one coalesced Games/library refresh after completion. Preserve Wii/GameCube hidden artwork aliases with pretty display names, Dolphin saves/artwork, curated Apps/app artwork, concurrent transfers/ETA/history retention, hitch guards, compiled 0.26.5/x64 stamp, installer rollback/tamper, Steam ownership, Nintendo ownership and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 presentation. Upload only if the staged candidate records unifiedSystemCursorGate, nativeWebPointerGate, nativeStreamingChromeSuppressionGate, activeDownloadLibraryStabilityGate, completionOnlyLibraryRefreshGate and inPlaceDownloadTelemetryGate success along with all prior Sony HID, Game Bar, Wii alias, streaming, provider, installer and freeze gates.
